explanation: This fires only at D1 and only late in the episode (about trial 85 onward), when the previous trial was unrewarded: the first unrewarded D1 in a run is about 6-7 (occasionally 0), the second and third consecutive unrewarded D1s are 9-10, and it drops to 0-1 once a trial is rewarded again (or about 6 if the run then continues after a switch in choice). It is 0 at every GO and D2 step, at every D1 after a reward, and at all steps before about trial 85, whatever the rewards were.
